# Theme 6: Applied ML Research {.unnumbered}

<!-- This file is the source of a page on the course website. Read it there: https://ai.buas.nl/open-courses/introduction-to-ml/self-study/theme-6/00_overview.html -->

A model is only useful when others understand what you did, and research often has a better approach than the one you would come up with yourself. In this theme you learn to present and write about technical work, to find and read machine-learning research, and to test an idea from a paper yourself.

## What you will be able to do

After this theme you can:

- prepare presentations and documents with your own checklists;
- find, read and judge machine-learning papers;
- test an idea from a paper in your own project and report the evidence.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [Communicating Technical Work](01_communicating_technical_work.qmd), about 4 hours: a lecture on presenting and one on writing, and your own checklists for both.
2. [Understanding ML Research](02_understanding_ml_research.qmd), about 2 hours: types of research output, the scientific method, research metrics, and how to find and access papers.
3. [Research to Practice](03_from_research_to_practice.qmd), about 6 hours: read a machine-learning paper and test one of its principles in a project of your own.
4. [Review](04_review.qmd), about 15 minutes: a summary of the theme and a short quiz.

This is the last theme of the Self-study.
